text: What technology do you use when you study?

speaker: B
name: Mia
text: Absolutely AI — like ChatGPT, and Doubao here in China. AI is really, really useful and widely used. I think everyone in this generation must use AI — not "should," must. I use it to solve problems I meet in my studies, to communicate in English, and to improve my English as well.
